claim_ceiling.statement: The Freitag-Salvati Manni level-theta package source-binds a symplectic level-4 structure on an elliptic curve E and a Weil-pairing-preserving isomorphism beta:E[8]->F[8], but it does not source-bind a branch-labelled symplectic H1/J(C0)[2] marking of the Bolza Jacobian. If one attempts a Frey-Kani-style principal-polarized gluing, beta must first be converted to an anti-isometry by an additional choice. There are 384 determinant -1 automorphisms of (Z/8Z)^2, reducing uniformly to all six GL2(F2) elements, so that optional construction retains the full three-direction mod-2 ambiguity. No absolute retained W-line or Q602 residue follows.

freitag_salvati_manni.title: Parametrization of the box variety by theta functions
locators: Section 2, Theorem 2.4 and Lemmas 2.2-2.3: theta-coordinate parametrization and Gamma[4]/Gamma[8] action
Section 6, definition of symplectic level-N structure preserving the Weil pairing
Section 6, Theorems 6.3-6.4: M(4,8) and the finite box variety
exact_supported_facts: a level N structure on an elliptic curve is an isomorphism (Z/NZ)^2 -> E[N]
the considered level structures preserve the standard symplectic pairing and the Weil pairing
Q(zeta8)-points of the finite box variety correspond to pairs E,F with a level-4 structure and a compatible isomorphism beta:E[8]->F[8] preserving the Weil pairing
the modular parameterization is built from elliptic modular curves H/Gamma[8], not from a branch-labelled genus-2 homology basis

frey_kani_gluing_reference.exact_fact_used: To obtain a principally polarized abelian surface by gluing E and F along n-torsion, the graph datum is an anti-isometry for the Weil pairing; a pairing-preserving beta is not itself that anti-isometry.

stoll_verification.exact_supported_scope: explicit box-surface coordinates, curves, automorphism substitutions, Picard action, and Galois action
stoll_verification.does_not_supply_in_inspected_scope: an elliptic level-8 to branch-labelled Bolza H1/J[2] adapter

fsm_level_structure_type_check.source_object: pair of elliptic curves (E,F) with level structure / torsion isomorphism
fsm_level_structure_type_check.source_beta: beta:E[8] -> F[8] preserving the Weil pairing
fsm_level_structure_type_check.target_object_needed: branch-labelled symplectic H1(C0,Z) or J(C0)[2] marking tied to retained principal-Bolza basis
fsm_level_structure_type_check.missing_semantic_adapter: elliptic-pair level data -> the specific principal-polarized Bolza Jacobian -> branch-labelled retained J[2] basis
fsm_level_structure_type_check.existing_beauville_bolza_identification_: The retained Stage32 correspondence identifies the quotient curve C0 and its unpolarized J(C0)~=E^2 description, but does not transport the FSM level basis into the retained branch-labelled J[2] marking.

optional_frey_kani_anti_isometry_preflig.purpose: Quantify the extra ambiguity if one tries to convert the FSM symplectic beta into a principal-polarized genus-2 gluing datum.
optional_frey_kani_anti_isometry_preflig.matrix_identity: For a 2x2 matrix A over Z/8Z, A^T J A = det(A) J.
optional_frey_kani_anti_isometry_preflig.consequence: Without an extra anti-isometry/gluing choice, the optional Frey-Kani route carries a full transitive S3 ambiguity on the three nonzero 2-torsion directions.

comparison_with_existing_stage32_fsm_act.known_conditional_if_fsm_S_equals_princi: delta_0inf remains on two possible retained lines L2/L3
comparison_with_existing_stage32_fsm_act.reason: The level-structure theorem marks elliptic torsion data but does not identify the modular S with one exact retained principal-Bolza lattice generator on a common marked ppav.

decision.new_exact_scratch_fact: FSM supplies genuine symplectic elliptic level data, but its semantic object is not the branch-labelled Bolza Jacobian marking required by EX4. An attempted principal-polarized gluing introduces an unconstrained 384-element anti-isometry choice whose mod-2 image is full S3.
decision.current_missing_datum: A source-bound adapter from the FSM elliptic level structure to the specific Bolza principal polarization and branch-labelled J(C0)[2] basis, including the anti-isometry/gluing choice if Frey-Kani is used.
decision.next_lane_objective: Use source-bound complex-conjugation / sqrt(2)-conjugation actions already present on the box/Picard side and test whether a semilinear action can distinguish a proper subset of the 48 retained ppav/CM markings. Do not reuse bare theta-level or mod-2 conjugacy.
decision.reason_no_claim_sync: Scratch-only materially distinct source diagnostic; no retained consolidation, authority/audit transition, promotion, frontier remap, or final milestone.
